extensionPolicy: APEX 26.2 uses a separate extension catalog and separate evidence; never mix its results into this baseline.
performanceBudgetPolicy: Initial diagnostic budgets, not a vendor SLA or qualified benchmark. Less than 20 samples cannot qualify p95.

cases.title: MCP startup and ten-tool discovery
steps: List tools through real stdio MCP.
expected: Exactly ten unique supported tools; removed controllers absent.

cases.title: Doctor and compiler prerequisites

expected: Node, Java and SQLcl are detected; no database call or automatic download.

cases.title: Scoped metadata pagination
steps: Read pages with limit 1; repeat with returned offset.
expected: No duplicate/missing IDs on a stable target; untrusted classification retained.

cases.title: Foreign schema rejection

expected: SCHEMA_DENIED before Oracle query.

cases.title: Missing object rejection
